# Gramlot DevTools 0.1.4 — Structural Source editing

- Bundle the shared Inspector from Gramlot 0.3.2.
- Insert and delete Source nodes, reorder or reparent them by drag, and Undo/Redo structural and property changes.
- Preserve parent component requirements and conflict checks through the extension bridge.
- Retain existing Data editing, breakpoints, frame selection and reconnection behavior.

Verified with unit/protocol tests, extension browser checks and real Chrome DevTools qualification. No Chrome Web Store submission is part of this release.
